rows.output: "Ẹ jẹ́ kí ìwádìí AI pọ̀ sí i ní ìlọ́po méjì yóò jẹ́ ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ tó dára, níwọ̀n bí gbogbo orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn ti jìnnà jù lọ sí U.S., a sì ń wá ìbáṣepọ̀ tó kàn ní AI," ni Lee sọ.

rows.output: Ààrẹ Gjorge Ivanov ti sọ pé kò ní dibo nínú ìdìbò náà, àti ìpolongo ìkọ̀sẹ̀ kan ti mú kí ìdánilójú wà nípa bóyá ìdìbò tó tóbi tó 50% yóò wà fún ìdìbò náà láti jẹ́ òtítọ́.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ Gjorge Ivanov ti sọpé òun kòní dìbò ninu ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ àtipé ìpolongo fún ìdẹ́yẹsí kan ti jẹ́kí àwọn ìsiyèméjì wà lórí bóyá ìjádedìbò yóò tó ìdá àádọ́ta ninu ọgọ́ọ̀rún eyiti i ṣe iye tó kéré jùlọ tí wọ́n nílò fún ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ náà láti jẹ́ eyiti ó wúlò.

rows.output: Ìbéèrè tí wọ́n fi nínú ìdìbò náà ni: "Ṣé o fẹ́ NATO àti ìṣèjọba EU pẹ̀lú ìfọwọ́sí àdéhùn pẹ̀lú Gíríìsì."
rows.reference: Ìbéèrè náà lóri ìwé àmútẹ̀kasí fún ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ náà kà báyìí: ''Ṣe o faramọ́ ìjọ́mọ-ẹgbẹ́ àjọ NATO àti EU pẹ̀lú ìtẹ́wọ́gbà ti àdéhùn náà pẹ̀lú orilẹ-ede Gíríkì.''.

rows.output: Àwọn olùfọkànsìn fún orúkọ yíyí, títí kan Ààrẹ Zoran Zaev, jiyàn pé ó jẹ́ owó tí ó tọ́ láti ṣe àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ láti wọlé sínú àwọn ẹgbẹ́ bí EU àti NATO fún Masedonia, ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí ó jáde láti inú ìparun Yugoslavia.
rows.reference: Àwọn alátìlẹyìn ti ìyípadà orúkọ náà, pẹ̀lú Adarí Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìjọba Zoran Zaev, wí àwíjàre wipe ó jẹ́ ìdíyelé tóyẹ kan láti san láti leè lépa ìgbaniwọlé sinu àwọn àjọ bíi EU àti NATO fún Masidóníà, ọ̀kan ninu àwọn orilẹ̀-ede tó yọ jáde síta láti inú ìwólulẹ̀ ti Orilẹ-ede Yugosilafia.

rows.output: Mo wá lónìí láti dìbò fún ọjọ́ iwájú orílẹ̀-èdè náà, fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní Masedonià kí wọ́n lè máa gbé ní òmìnira lábẹ́ àpò ìdánimọ̀ Ìparapọ̀ Àwọn Orílẹ̀-èdè Yúróòpù nítorí pé ó túmọ̀ sí àwọn ìgbésí ayé ààbò fún gbogbo wa,” ni Olívera Georgijevska, 79, sọ ní Skopje.
rows.reference: Mó wá lóòní láti di ìbò fún ọjọ́ iwájú orilẹ-ede náà, fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní Masidóníà kí wọ́n leè máa gbé ní òmìnira lábẹ́ agboòrùn ti Àjọ Àwọn Orilẹ-ede Yuroopu nitoripe ó túmọ̀ sí àwọn ìgbésí ayé aláìléwu púpọ̀ síi fún gbogbo wa,'' gẹgẹ bíi Olivera Georgijevska, ẹni ọdún mọ́kàndínlọ́gọ́rin ṣe sọ, ní ìlú Skopje.

rows.output: Bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé kò ní jẹ́ òfin, àwọn ọmọ ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin tó tóbi tó ti sọ pé wọ́n máa bọ́ sí ipinnu ìdìbò náà láti jẹ́ kí ó ṣe pàtàkì.
rows.reference: Botilẹjepe kìí ṣe àdéhùn tó ńfipá múni lábẹ̀ òfin, àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ilé ìgbìmọ aṣojú-ṣòfin tí ó tóníye ti sọpé àwọn faramọ̀ àbájáde ìbò náà láti ṣeé ní eyiti ẹnu rẹ̀ múlẹ̀.

rows.output: Ìyípadà orúkọ náà yóò nílò ìdá méjìlá nínú mẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́dógún nínú ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin.
rows.reference: Ìyípadà orúkọ náà yóò nílò ìdá méjì tópọ̀jù ninu ìdá mẹ́ta àwọn ọmọ ilé ìgbìmọ aṣojú-ṣòfin.

rows.output: Ìjọba ìdìbò sọ pé kò sí ìròyìn ìwà ìbàjẹ́ ní 1 ìrọ̀lẹ́.
rows.reference: Ìgbìmọ̀ amúṣẹ́ṣe lori ìdìbò ti orilẹ-ede náà sọpé kòsí àwọn ìròyìn àìṣedéédéé kankan títí aago méjì ọ̀sán.

rows.output: Báwo ló ṣe rí lára ​​àwọn tó wà níbẹ̀, ó kéré tó 16%, ní ìfiwéra pẹ̀lú 34% nínú ìdìbò àpéjọpọ̀ tó ṣe ní ọdún 2016 nígbà tí 66% àwọn tó forúkọ sílẹ̀ dìbò.
rows.reference: Bótiwùkórí, ìjáde-dìbò dúró ní ìdá mẹ́rìndínlógún ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀run, bí a ṣafiwé rẹ̀ sì ìdá mẹ́rìnlélọ́gbọ̀n ti inú ìdìbò àwọn aṣojú-ṣòfin tókọjá lọ́dún 2016 nigbati ìdá mẹ́rìndínláàádọ́rin àwọn olùdìbò tó forúkọ sílẹ̀ fi ìwé àmútẹkasí láti dìbo wọn sílẹ̀.

rows.output: Mo jade lati dibo nitori awọn ọmọ mi, ibi wa ni Yuroopu," ni Gjose Tanevski, 62, oludibo ni olu-ilu, Skopje.
rows.reference: ''Mo jáde síta láti dìbò nitori àwọn ọmọ mi, ipò wa wà ninu Yuroopu,'' gẹgẹ bíi Gjose Tanevski, ẹni ọdún méjìlélọ́gọ́ta, olùdìbo kan ní olù-ìlú náà, Skopje ṣe sọ.

rows.output: Waliyai na Welsh suna damuwa da "kama kamar muppets"
rows.reference: Welsh AMs ta damu game da 'yadda ake zama kamar wawaye'

rows.output: Akwai damuwa a tsakanin wasu AMs game da shawarar canza taken su zuwa MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).
rows.reference: Akwai tsoron haɗari a tsakanin wasu AMs a bisa shawarar canza muƙaminsu zuwa MWPs (Mamban Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh).

rows.output: An taso ne saboda shirye-shiryen canza sunan majalisar zuwa Majalisar Wales.
rows.reference: Abin ya tashi ne saboda shirye-shirye na canza sunan taron zuwa Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh.

rows.output: AMs a ko'ina cikin fagen siyasa suna damuwa cewa zai iya haifar da dariya.
rows.reference: AM a ɓangaren siyasa sun damu ƙwarai don zai iya haifar da ba’a.

rows.output: Wani dan jam'iyyar Labour ya ce rukunin sa na damuwa "yana daidaita da Twp da Pwp."
rows.reference: Wani AM na Jam’iyyar Labour ya ce ƙungiyar ta damu "yana rauji da Twp da kuma Pwp."

rows.output: Ga masu karatu a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh twp yana nufin daft da pwp yana nufin kaho.
rows.reference: Don masu karatu a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh twp yana nufin hauka kuma pwp yana nufin kashi.

rows.output: Wani memba na jam'iyyar Plaid ya ce, "ba su yi farin ciki ba" kuma sun ba da shawarwari na madadin.
rows.reference: Wani Plaid AM ya ce gungun gaba ɗaya “ba su ji daɗi ba” kuma ya ba da shawarar zaɓuɓɓuka.

rows.output: Wani mai ra'ayin mazan jiya na Welsh ya ce kungiyarsa tana "bude tunani" game da canjin suna, amma ya lura cewa yana da gajeren tafiya daga MWP zuwa Muppet.
rows.reference: Wani mai ra’ayin riƙau na Welsh ya ce gungun “ba shi da wani abu a zuciya” game da canza sunan, amma ya lura wani ɗan gajeren bayani ne daga MWP zuwa Muppet.

rows.output: A cikin wannan mahallin harafin Welsh w ana furta shi kamar yadda ake furta harafin u na Ingilishi na Yorkshire.
rows.reference: A wannan bigiren, ana furta harafin w na Welsh ne kwatankwacin furucin Turanci na Yorshire na harafin u.

rows.output: Hukumar Majalisar, wacce a halin yanzu tana aikin tsara dokoki don gabatar da canje-canjen suna, ta ce: "Shawarar karshe kan duk wani bayanin abin da ake kira Majalisar, ba shakka za ta kasance alhakin mambobin kansu."
rows.reference: Hukumar Majalisar, wanda a yanzu haka ke rubuta daftarin dokar don gabatar da canje-canjen sunan, ta ce:  “Hukuncin ƙarshe a kan kowaɗanne abubuwa masu bayyanarwa abin da ake kiran mambobi na Majalisar zai kasance kuwa wani batu ne don mambobin da kansu.”

rows.output: Dokar Gwamnatin Wales ta 2017 ta ba Majalisar Welsh damar canza sunanta.
rows.reference: Dokar Gwamnatin Welsh ta 2017 ta ba wa majalisar Welsh iko na canza sunanta.

rows.output: A watan Yuni, Hukumar ta buga sakamakon wani taro na jama'a kan shawarwarin da suka nuna goyon baya mai fadi na kiran taron a matsayin Majalisar Wales.
rows.reference: A cikin Yuni, Hukumar ta wallafa sakamako na wata tattaunawar jama’a a kan ƙudurorin wadanda suka sami babban goyon baya don kiran majalisar Majalisar Dokokin Welsh.

rows.output: A kan batun sunan AMs, hukumar ta fi son mambobin Majalisar Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi yawan goyon baya a cikin tattaunawar jama'a.
rows.reference: A kan batun sunan AMs ɗin, Hukumar ta fi son Mambobin Majalisar Dokokin Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi goyon bayan a cikin wata tattaunawar jama’a.

rows.output: Ana nuna AMs suna ba da wasu zaɓuɓɓuka, amma gwagwarmayar isa ga yarjejeniya na iya zama matsala ga Shugaban Majalisar, Elin Jones, wanda ake sa ran zai gabatar da kudurin doka kan canje-canje cikin makonni.
rows.reference: A fili AMs suna ba da shawarar wasu zaɓuɓɓuka ne, amma gwagwarmayar isa ga matsaya za ta iya zama mai wahala ga Jami’i Mai Kula, Elin Jones, wanda ake tsammanin za ta mila daftarin dokar a kan canje-canje a cikin makonni.

rows.output: Dokar gyaran da za ta hada da sauran gyare-gyare ga yadda majalisar ke aiki, ciki har da ka’idoji kan korar mambobin majalisar da kuma tsarin tsarin kwamitocin.
rows.reference: Dokar a kan canje-canjen za su haɗa da sauran canje-canje na yadda majalisar ke aiki, da ya haɗa da ƙa’idoji a kan ayyana rashin cancanta na AMs da kuma tsara tsari na kwamitin.

rows.output: Masu jefa kuri'a za su yi kuri'a ta karshe kan yadda za a kira su lokacin da suke tattaunawa kan dokar.
rows.reference: AMs za su sami kaɗa kuri’ar karshe a kan batun abin da za a kira su da shi a yayin da suka yi mahawarar dokar.

rows.output: Macedonians suna kada kuri'a a zaben da za a canza sunan kasar
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia sun tafi yin zaɓuɓɓuka a cikin zaɓen raba gardama a kan canza sunan kasar

rows.output: Masu kada kuri'a za su kada kuri'a a ranar Lahadi kan ko za su canza sunan kasarsu zuwa "Jamhuriyar Masedoniya ta Arewa."
rows.reference: Masu kada kuri’a za su yi zaɓe a kan ko su canza sunan kasarsu zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Macedonia ta Arewa.”

rows.output: An kafa kuri'ar jama'a ne da nufin warware takaddamar da aka dade ana yi da kasar makwabciyar Girka, wadda ke da lardi mai suna Macedonia.
rows.reference: An saita sanannen zaɓen ne don wani ƙoƙari na warware wani rikicin da ya yi shekara da shekara tare da makwaɓciyar ƙasa ta Greece, wadda ke da lardinta da ake kira Macedonia.

rows.output: Athens ta yi iƙirarin cewa sunan makwabtansu na arewa yana wakiltar ikirarin su kan ƙasar su kuma sun yi adawa da neman shiga EU da NATO akai-akai.
rows.reference: Athens ta jima tana jajircewa cewa sunan makwaɓciyarta daga arewaci yana wakiltar wani ƙorafi ne a kan yankinta kuma ta sha maimaita ƙin neman matsayin mamba a Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Shugaban kasar Masedoniya Gjorge Ivanov, wanda ya koma bayan yin zabe kan sauya sunan kasar, ya ce zai yi watsi da zaben.
rows.reference: Shugaban Ƙasar Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, wani mai adawa da tsarin zaɓen kai tsaye a kan canza sunan, ya ce zai yi watsi da zaɓen.

rows.output: Duk da haka, masu goyon bayan zaben sun hada da Firayim Minista Zoran Zaev, suna jayayya cewa canjin sunan kawai farashin da za a biya don shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Amma, masu goyon bayan zaɓen raba gardamar, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, suna mahawara cewa canza sunan wani ɗan aiki ne da dole a yi don a shiga Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Kafafun St. Martin sun yi shiru yayin da coci-coci ke fafutukar kare su a Harlem
rows.reference: Ƙararrawar St. Martin's Sun yi Shiru Saboda Majami’u a cikin Harlem suna cikin Gwargwarmaya

rows.output: "A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai mashaya da coci a kowane lungu," in ji Mista Adams.
rows.reference: “A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai wata mashaya da wata majami’a a kowace kusurwa,” Inji Mista Adams.

rows.output: "A yau, babu."
rows.reference: “A yau kuwa, babu ko ɗaya.”

rows.output: Ya ce bacewar mashaya ta yiwuwa.
rows.reference: Ya ce ɓacewa ta mashayun abu ne na fahimta.

rows.output: "Yanzu mutane suna mu'amala da juna ta hanyoyi daban-daban," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Mutane suna shaƙatawa ta wata hanya daban” a ranakun nan, injin shi.

rows.output: "An daina ganin mashaya a matsayin dakunan zama na unguwa inda mutane ke zuwa akai-akai."
rows.reference: “Mashayu yanzu ba ɗakuna ne da ke makwaɓta ba inda mutane ke zuwa a-kai-a-kai.”

rows.output: Game da coci, yana damuwa cewa kudin da ake samu daga sayar da kadarori ba zai dore ba kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammani, "kuma nan ba da jimawa ba za su kasance a inda suka fara."
rows.reference: A game da majami’un, ya damu cewa kuɗin da ake samu daga sayar da kadarori ba za su jima idan kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammani ba, “kuma nan ba da jimawa ba ko daga baya za su dawo idan suka fara.”

rows.output: Coci-coci, in ji shi, za a iya maye gurbinsu da gine-ginen gidaje da gidajen da aka cika da irin mutanen da ba za su taimaka wa sauran masallatan unguwar ba.
rows.reference: Ya ƙara da cewa, za a musanya majami’u da gine-ginen gidaje tare da manyan wurarene masu cike da irin mutane waɗanda ba za su taimaka ga sauran wuraren samun mafaka na makwaɓta.

rows.output: "Yawan mutanen da ke sayen gidajen haya a cikin waɗannan gine-gine za su kasance farar fata," in ji shi, "kuma hakan zai hanzarta ranar da waɗannan coci-coci za su rufe gaba ɗaya saboda ba zai yiwu ba cewa yawancin waɗannan mutanen da za su koma waɗannan gidajen haya za su zama membobin waɗannan coci-coci."
rows.reference: “Mafi yawan mutane da za su sayi manyan wurare a cikin waɗannan gine-ginen za su kasance farar fata ne,” inji shi, “don haka kuwa za su gaggauta ranar da za a ce waɗannan majami’u sun rufe gaba ɗaya saboda akwai yiwuwar mafi yawanci waɗannan mutane da suka motsa cikin wadannan manyan wuraren su zama mambobi na waɗannan majami’u.”

rows.output: Dukkan majami'u biyu an gina su ne da al'ummomin fari kafin Harlem ta zama birnin bakar fata - Majami'ar Al'umma a shekara ta 1870, St. Martin a shekara ta 1880.
rows.reference: Duka majami’un guda biyu farar fata ne suka gina su kafin Harlem ta zama alƙaryar baƙaƙen fata - Al’ummar da ke Alƙaryar a 1870, shekaru goma bayan St. Martin’s.

rows.output: Ƙungiyar Methodist ta farko ta koma wani wuri a shekarun 1930.
rows.reference: Asalin farar fata mahalarta ‘yan Methodist sun fita ne a cikin shekaru na 1930.

rows.output: Jama'ar bakar fata da suka yi ibada a kusa da su sun karbi mallakar ginin.
rows.reference: Wani taron masu ibada baƙaƙe da ke yin ibada a kusa suka mallaki ginin.

rows.output: An kama St. Martin da wani gungun bakar fata karkashin jagorancin Rev. John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci yajin aikin da ya shafi shaguna a kan titin 125, babban titin sayayya a Harlem, wadanda suka yi adawa da daukar ma'aikata ko inganta bakar fata.
rows.reference: Taron baƙaƙen fata masu ibada ne suka karɓe ragamar St. Martin’s a ƙarƙashin Rabaran John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci ‘yan kasuwa da su ƙaurace ma sayen kaya a kan layi na 125, wani babban layin yin sayayya a Harlem, wanda ya jajirce a wajen yin hayar ma’aikata ko tallafawa baƙaƙen fata.

rows.output: Wuta a shekarar 1939 ta yi mummunar barna a ginin, amma yayin da mabiya cocin Father Johnson suka fara shirin sake gina shi, sun ba da umarnin kiran kararrawa.
rows.reference: Wata gobara a cikin 1939 ta lalata ginin sosai, amma kamar yadda mabiyan Fada Johnson suka yi shirye-shirye na sake ginin, su ne suka buɗe kayan kiɗan majami’ar.

rows.output: Mai bishara Dauda Yohanna, ɗan uban sa kuma wanda ya gaje shi a cocin St. Martin, ya yi alfahari da kiran kararrawa "bell din talakawa."
rows.reference: Rabaran David Johnson, dan Fada Johnson da wanda ya gaje shi a St. Martin's, a cikin alfahari ya kiran kayan kiɗan majami’ar “ƙararrawowin mutane talakawa.”

rows.output: Kwararren mai kida wanda ya buga kararrawa a watan Yuli ya kira shi wani abu dabam: "Kasadar al'adu" da "kayan tarihi maras maye."
rows.reference: Ƙwararren da ya kaɗa ƙararrawar a watan Yuli ya kira shi da wani abu daban: “Wata ajiyayyar dukiyar al’ada” da “wani kayan tarihi da ba za a iya maida gurbinsa ba.”

rows.output: Kwararre, Tiffany Ng daga Jami'ar Michigan, ta lura cewa ita ce motar farko a duniya da ta buga ta da dan wasan baki, Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya koma babbar motar a Cocin Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.
rows.reference: Kwararren, Tiffany Ng na Jami’ar Michigan, har ila yau ya lura cewa shi ne kayan kiɗa na farko a duniya da wani mawaki baƙar fata ya rera, wato Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya motsa babban kayan kiɗan a Majami’ar Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.

rows.output: Mista Merriweather ya ce cewa St. Martin's ba su maye gurbinsa ba.
rows.reference: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin's ɗin ba ta musanya shi ba.

rows.output: Abin da ya faru a St. Martin a cikin watanni da suka gabata ya kasance wani labari mai rikitarwa na masu zanen gine-gine da masu gini, wasu da shugabannin cocin suka kawo, wasu kuma da bishop din cocin Anglican.
rows.reference: Abin da ya bayyana a St. Martin’s a ‘yan watanni da suka wuce ya zama wani labari mai ruɗarwa na masana zane da ‘yan kwangila, wasu da shugabannin majami’ar da ba su da ilimi suka kawo, sauran kuwa daga ikon babban limamin ‘yan Episcopal.

rows.output: Majalisar cocin - wacce ta kunshi shugabannin da ba na addini ba, ta rubuta wa bishop a watan Yuli da damuwarta cewa bishop din "zai yi ƙoƙarin watsa farashi" ga majalisar, duk da cewa majalisar ba ta shiga cikin daukar masu zanen gado da masu gini da bishop din ya aiko ba.
rows.reference: Sai kwamitin vestry ɗin - hukumar gudanar da yankin iyakar majami’ar, da ta haɗa da shugabanni da ba su da ilimi - sun rubuta wa babban limamin a Yuli da damuwowinsu cewa yankin iyakar majami’ar “zai nemi mika kuɗaɗen da aka kashe” zuwa kwamitin vestry ɗin, duk da cewa ba a sa kwamitin vestry ɗin ba a yin hayar masu zanen da ‘yan kwangilar da yankin iyakar majami’ar suka sa ba.

rows.output: Wasu mabiya cocin sun yi korafi game da rashin gaskiya a bangaren cocin.
rows.reference: Wasu mabiya sun yi ƙorafi game da rashin bayyana abin da aka yi ta ɓangaren yankin iyakar majami’ar.

rows.output: Wani kifi ya raunata wani yaro mai shekaru 13 a lokacin da yake nutsewa don kama lobster a California.
rows.reference: Babban kifin teku ya raunata mai iyon neman lobster ɗan shekaru 13 a California

rows.output: Wani kifi mai kai hari ya raunata wani yaro dan shekara 13 a ranar Asabar, yayin da yake nutsewa don kama kifi a California a ranar farko da aka fara kamun lobster, jami'ai sun bayyana.
rows.reference: Wani babban kifin teku ya kai hari da raunata wani yaro mai shekaru 13 a ranar Asabar a lokacin da yake iyon neman losbter a cikin California a ranar buɗe lokacin lobster, kamar yadda jami’ai suka ce.

rows.output: Harin ya faru da misalin karfe 7 na safe kusa da bakin teku na Beacon a Encinitas.
rows.reference: Harin ya faru ne kawai kafin ƙarfe 7 na safe kusa da Bakin Tekun Beacon a cikin Encinitas.

rows.output: Shirye-shiryen Sainsbury na shiga kasuwar kyau ta Burtaniya
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana shirye-shiryen shiga kasuwar kwalliya ta Birtaniyya

rows.output: Sainsbury's yana fafatawa da Boots, Superdrug da Debenhams da layukan kantin sayar da kayan kwalliya da ma'aikatan kwararru ke tafiyar da su.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana ɗaukan Boots, Superdrug da Debenhams tare da irin ɓangarorin shagon salon kwalliya da aka ɗauka masa ma’aikata da ƙwararrun masu ba da taimako.

rows.output: A matsayin wani bangare na ƙoƙarin shiga kasuwar kyau ta Burtaniya ta £2.8bn, wacce ke ci gaba da girma yayin da sayar da kayan ado da na gida ke faduwa, manyan sassan kyau za a gwada a cikin shaguna 11 a duk faɗin ƙasar kuma a ɗauka zuwa ƙarin shaguna a shekara mai zuwa idan ya yi nasara.
rows.reference: A matsayin ɓangaren shiga cikin kasuwar kwalliya ta Birtaniyya ta Fam biliyan 2.8, wadda ke ci gaba da haɓaka duk da cewa cinikayyar ado da kayan gida ta sami koma baya, za a gwada manyan ɓangarorin kwalliya a shaguna 11 na kasar kuma a ɗauke su zuwa ƙarin shaguna a shekara mai zuwa idan abin ya ci wata nasara.

rows.output: Zuba jari a cikin kyawun yana faruwa ne yayin da manyan kantuna ke neman hanyoyin amfani da sararin saman da aka yi amfani da su a baya don talabijan, microwave, da kayan daki.
rows.reference: Zuba jari a harkar kwalliya yana zuwa ne kamar yadda manyan shagunan sayar da kaya ke fafutukar hanyoyi don yin amfani da gurbin da babu kome da a da na ajiye talabijoji ne, da na’urorin dafa abinci da kayan gida.

rows.output: Sainsbury's ya ce zai ninka girman kayan kwalliyar sa zuwa samfuran 3,000, ciki har da alamomi kamar Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman da Dr. PawPaw a karon farko.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s ya ce zai ruɓanya girma na abubuwan da zai samar na kwalliya har kusan kayayyaki 3,000, da suka haɗa da nau’uka kamar su Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman da Dokta PawPaw a lokaci na farko.

rows.output: Kasancewar daga L'Oreal, Maybelline da Bees na Burton za su sami ƙarin sarari tare da wuraren da aka yi wa alama irin waɗanda aka samu a shaguna kamar Boots.
rows.reference: Ranji-ranji da ke nan daga L'Oreal, Maybelline da Burt's Bees su ma za su sami gurbi masu yankin nau’uka iri ɗaya da waɗanda ake samu a cikin shaguna kamar Boots.

rows.output: Kantin sayar da kayayyaki na kasuwa kuma yana sake kaddamar da layin kayan shafa na Boutique don haka mafi yawan samfuran suna da abinci maras kyau - wani abu da ake bukata sosai da matasa masu siyayya ke nema.
rows.reference: Haka kuma babban shagon zai sake ƙaddamar da ranjinsa na kayan zamani saboda mafi yawancin kayayyakin su zama na abotar vegan - wani abin da ke samun ƙaruwar buƙata ga kananan masu yin ciniki.

rows.output: Bugu da ƙari, mai sayar da ƙamshin, The Fragrance Shop, zai gwada shagunan sayar da kayayyaki a cikin shaguna biyu na Sainsbury, na farko da aka bude a Croydon, kudu London, a makon da ya gabata, yayin da na biyu ya bude a Selly Oak, Birmingham, a karshen wannan shekara.
rows.reference: Kari a kan haka, mai sarin turare wato Shagon Turare zai gwada samar da rangwame a cikin shagunan Sainsbury's guda biyu, na farkonsu wanda ya buɗe a cikin Croydon, kudancin Landan, makon da ya wuce sa’an nan na biyun zai buɗe a cikin Selly Oak, Birmingham, daga baya cikin wannan shekarar.

rows.output: Siyan kan layi da kuma sauyin zuwa sayen kadan na abinci kowace rana a shagunan sayar da kayayyaki na gida yana nufin cewa manyan kantuna suna buƙatar yin ƙarin ƙoƙari don shawo kan mutane su ziyarce su.
rows.reference: Sayan kaya ta yanar gizo da ‘yar matsawa zuwa sayan abinci kadan a kowace rana a shaguna masu samar da sauki na gida yana nufi ya zama dole manyan shagunan sayar da kayan su himmatu wajen jan hankalin mutane su ziyarta.

rows.output: Mai gudanarwa na Sainsbury, Mike Coupe, ya ce shagunan za su yi kama da shagunan sashe yayin da kungiyar ke kokarin yaki da masu rangwame Aldi da Lidl da karin ayyuka da kayayyaki marasa abinci.
rows.reference: Mike Coupe, shugaban Sainsbury's, ya ce shagunan gefen za su ci gaba da zama kamar manyan shaguna masu ɓangarori kamar yadda jerin babban shagon ke ƙoƙarin gasa da masu rangwame Aldi da Lidl tare da karin ayyuka da wanda ba na abinci ba.

rows.output: Sainsbury's ya sanya wuraren Argos a cikin shaguna da dama kuma ya gabatar da wasu wuraren Habitat tun da ya sayi duka sarkar shekaru biyu da suka wuce, wanda ya ce ya kara sayar da kayan abinci da kuma sa sayen ya fi riba.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana sa wuraren sayarwa na gefe na Argos a cikin ɗaruruwan shaguna haka kuma ya gabatar da wasu Habitats tun da ya saye gaba ɗaya jerinsu shekaru biyu da suka wuce, wanda yake cewa ya ƙara inganta cinikayyar kayan abinci inda kuma ya sa samun ya zama mai riba.

rows.output: Ko da yake, an yi ƙoƙari na baya-bayan nan na sake fasalin sashen kyau da na magani a cikin babban kanti ya ci tura.
rows.reference: Ƙoƙarin da babban shagon ya yi na da a farfaɗo da ɓangarorin kwalliyar da magunguna ya ƙare babu nasara.

rows.output: Sainsbury ya gwada haɗin gwiwa tare da Boots a farkon shekarun 2000, amma an dakatar da haɗin gwiwar bayan rikici kan yadda za a raba kudaden shiga daga shagunan magani a cikin shagunan su.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s ya gwada wani haɗin gwiwar kasuwanci tare da Boots a farkon shekaru na 2000, amma haɗuwar ta zo ƙarshe a bayan wani rikici na yadda za a raba kuɗaɗen da ke shigowa daga shagunan magani a cikin manyan shagunan nasa.

rows.output: Sabuwar dabarar ta zo ne bayan Sainsbury ta sayar da kasuwancin asibitocin ta 281 ga Celesio, mai mallakar sarkar Lloyds Pharmacy, kan fam miliyan 125, shekaru uku da suka wuce.

rows.output: An ce Lloyds za ta taka rawa a cikin shirin, ta hanyar kara da yawa daga cikin manyan alamu na kula da fata ciki har da La Roche-Posay da Vichy a cikin shaguna hudu.

rows.output: Paul Mills-Hicks, Daraktan Harkokin Kasuwanci na Sainsbury, ya ce: "Mun canza kamannin da jin dadin shagunan mu na kyau don inganta yanayin ga abokan cinikinmu.

rows.output: Firaministan Birtaniya May ta zargi masu sukar ta da yin "siyasa" game da Brexit.
rows.reference: Firaministan Birtaniyya May ta kushe masu suka a kan Brexit da ‘yin siyasa’

rows.output: Firaminista Theresa May ta zargi masu sukar shirinta na ficewa daga Tarayyar Turai da yin “siyasa” da makomar Birtaniya da kuma kawo cikas ga muradun kasa a wata hira da jaridar Sunday Times.
rows.reference: Firaminista Theresa May ta soki masu suka na shirye-shiryenta na barin Tarayyar Turai da “maida abin siyasa” da makomar Birtaniyya da kuma zagon ƙasa ga abin da ƙasa ke sha’awa a cikin wata tattaunawa tare da jaridar Sunday Times.

rows.output: Babban Ministan Birtaniya Theresa May ya isa taron jam'iyyar Conservative a Birmingham, Birtaniya, 29 ga Satumba, 2018.
rows.reference: Firaministan Birtaniyya Theresa May ta zo Taron Jam’iyyar Conservative a cikin Birmingham, Birtaniyya, a ranar 29 ga Satumba, 2018.

rows.output: A wani hira da aka yi a gefen wanda aka yi da ita a shafin farko na jaridar, tsohon ministan harkokin waje Boris Johnson ya ci gaba da kai hare-hare a shirinta na Chequers na Brexit, inda ya ce shawarar cewa Birtaniya da EU su tattara haraji ga juna "abu ne mai ban mamaki."
rows.reference: A cikin wata tattaunawar a gaba da wadda aka yi da ita a kan shafin gaba na jaridar, tsohon ministanta kan harkokin ƙasashen waje Boris Johnson ya tirjewa a kan harinsa na shirin Chequers ɗin nata don Brexit, yana cewa wani ƙudurin da ke cewa ya kamata Birtaniyya da Tarayyar Turai su karɓi kuɗaɗen fito na juna ya kasance “gaba ɗaya shirme ne.”

rows.output: An kama wanda ake zargin Dyteon Simpson a cikin mutuwar Wayde Sims
rows.reference: Harbin Wayde Sims ‘Yan sanda sun kama Dyteon Simpson da ake tuhuma a kan kisan ɗan wasan LSU.

rows.output: An kama wani da ake zargi da harbin wanda ya yi sanadiyyar mutuwar Wayde Sims, wanda yake da shekaru 20, dan wasan kwallon kwando a Jami'ar Jihar Louisiana.
rows.reference: ‘Yan sanda sun kama wani da ake tuhuma a cikin mummunan harbi da ya kashe Wayde Sims, wani mai shekaru 20 kuma dan wasan ƙwallon kwando a LSU.

rows.output: Dyteon Simpson, mai shekaru 20, an kama shi kuma an mika shi ga gidan yari bisa laifin kisan kai na biyu, a cewar sashen ‘yan sandan Baton Rouge.
rows.reference: An kama Dyteon Simpson, mai shekaru 20 kuma an kai shi kurkuku a kan wata tuhumar kisa mai mataki na biyu, inji Ma’aikatar ‘Yan Sandan Baton Rouge.

rows.output: Jami'ai sun fitar da bidiyon fadan da ke tsakanin Sims da Simpson, kuma 'yan sanda sun ce Sims ya rasa gilashin sa a lokacin fadan.
rows.reference: Jami’ai sun saki bidiyo na takardamar tsakanin Sims da Simpson, kuma ‘yan sanda sun ce Sims ya rasa gilashinsa a lokacin fadan.

rows.output: An dawo da gilashin daga wurin da laifin ya faru, kuma sun ce sun sami DNA na Simpson a kan su, a cewar wani rahoto na CBS WAFB.
rows.reference: ‘Yan sanda sun sami gilashin daga wurin da aka aikata laifin inda suka kuma ce sun sami abin halittar DNA na Simpson a kansu, kamar yadda rahoton WAFB mai alaƙa da CBS ya faɗa.

rows.output: Bayan an yi wa Simpson tambayoyi, ‘yan sanda sun ce ya amince da harbin da ya yi wa Wayde.
rows.reference: Bayan tambayan Simpson, ‘yan sanda sun ce ya amsa laifi na mummunan harbin Wayde.

rows.output: An saita takardar shaidar sa a kan dala 350,000, a cewar The Advocate.
rows.reference: An sa kuɗin belinsa a dala 350,000, a cewar rahoton Advocate.

rows.output: Ofishin Coroner na East Baton Rouge Parish ya fitar da rahoton farko a ranar Jumma'a, yana mai cewa dalilin mutuwa shi ne raunin harbi a kai zuwa wuyan wuya.
rows.reference: Ofishin Mai Binciken a kan Musabbabin Kisa na Baton Rouge ta Gabas ya saki wani rahoton farko ranar Jumu’a, yana cewa musabbabin mutuwar wani harbin bindiga ne zuwa ga ka da ya wuce cikin wuya.

rows.output: Sashen yana ba da kiredit ga rundunar 'yan sandan jihar Louisiana, dakin binciken laifuka na jihar, 'yan sandan jami'ar Kudu, da 'yan kasa na yankin da suka taimaka wajen binciken da ya kai ga kama mutumin.
rows.reference: Ma’aikatar ta yabi jami’an ‘yan sanda na Jihar Louisiana masu aikin kama wanda ya gudu, da ɗakin ‘yan sanda na gwajin kimiyyar aikata lafi na jihar, da ‘yan sandan Jami’ar Kudanci da mazauna yanki don taimakawa a binciken da ya kai ga kamen.

rows.output: Daraktan wasanni na Jami’ar Jihar Louisiana Joe Alleva ya gode wa hukumomin tsaro na yankin bisa kokarinsu na “hakuri da neman adalci.”
rows.reference: Daraktan wasan tsalle-tsalle na LSU Joe Alleva ya gode wa ma’aikatan doka na yankin don irin aikinsu na “jajircewa da ganin an yi adalci.”

rows.output: Sims yana da shekaru ashirin.
rows.reference: Shekarun Sims 20 ne.

rows.output: Babban gaba mai tsayi ƙafa 6-6 ya girma a Baton Rouge, inda mahaifinsa, Wayne, ya kuma buga kwallon kwando ga LSU.
rows.reference: Mai tsawon tattaki 6 da 6 ya girma ne a cikin Baton Rouge, inda mahaifinsa, Wayne, shi ma ya buga wasan ƙwallon kwando ga LSU.

rows.output: Ya yi matsakaicin maki 5.6 da 2.6 a kowane wasa a kakar da ta gabata.
rows.reference: Yana da matsakaicin maki 5.6 da sake dawo da ƙididdigar ci na 2.6 a wani na lokacin da shuɗe.

rows.output: A safiyar Juma'a, koci kwallon kwando na Jami'ar Jihar Louisiana (LSU) Will Wade ya bayyana cewa kungiyar tana "cikin bakin ciki" kuma "ta yi mamaki" da mutuwar Wayde.
rows.reference: A ranar Juma’a da safe, mai horar da ‘yan wasan ƙwallon kwandon na LSU Will Wade ya ce ƙungiyar ta sami “tashin hankali” da “girgiza” da mutuwar ta Wayde.

rows.output: "Wannan shine abin da kuke damuwa da shi a kowane lokaci," Wade ya ce.
rows.reference: “Wannan shi ne abin mutum yake damuwa game da shi a dukkan lokaci,” inji Wade.

rows.output: Wani vulkana ya zubar da ash a kan birnin Mexico
rows.reference: Babban dutsi mai amon wuta ya fesa toka a kan Birnin Mexico

rows.output: Gobarar da ke fitowa daga tsaunin Popocatepetl ta kai yankunan kudu na babban birnin Mexico.
rows.reference: Toka da ke fesuwa daga babban dutsi mai amon wuta na Popocatepetl ta isa makwaɓta na kudancin babban birnin Mexico.

rows.output: Cibiyar Kasa ta Gargaɗin Bala'i ta gargadi 'yan kasar Mexico a ranar Asabar da su kauce wa tsaunin bayan da aka samu karuwar ayyukan a cikin kwarin sa, kuma ya rubuta fitar da iskar gas da ash 183 a cikin sa'o'i 24.
rows.reference: Cibiyar Hana Haɗura ta Ƙasa ta gargaɗi ‘yan Mexico a ranar Asabar kar su kusanci dutsin bayan abin ya kai koli a farfashewar inda kuma a ka yi rijistar fitar da hayaƙi na iskar gas 183 da kuma toka ta fiye da sa’o’i 24.

rows.output: Cibiyar tana kula da tashin hankali da girgizar kasa da yawa.
rows.reference: Cibiyar tana kula da cidodi da girgize-girgizen ƙasa.

rows.output: Hotuna a shafukan sada zumunta sun nuna yadda guntun gari ke rufe tagogin motoci a unguwanni daban-daban na birnin Mexico kamar Xochimilco.
rows.reference: Hotuna a hanyar sadarwa ta zumunta sun nuna mashimfiɗu marassa kauri na toka suna danƙare a jikin gilasan mota a cikin makwaɓta na Birnin Mexico kamar su Xochimilco.

rows.output: Masana kimiyyar ƙasa sun lura da karuwar ayyuka a wani vulkan da ke da nisan mil 45 (kilomita 72) kudu maso gabashin babban birnin tun bayan girgizar kasa mai karfin 7.1 da ta afku a tsakiyar kasar Mexico a watan Satumba 2017.
rows.reference: Masana kimiyyar yanayi sun lura da wani karin aiki a dutsin da ke zaune a mil 45 (kilomita 72) kudu-maso-gabas na babban birnin tun daga wata girgizar kasa da aka yi mai girman 7.1 da ta raguza tsakiyar Mexico a Satumba 2017.

rows.output: An yi aikin vulkan da ake kira "Don Goyo" tun daga shekarar 1994.
rows.reference: Dutsi mai amon wutar da ake kira "Don Goyo" ya daɗe yana tashi tun 1994.

rows.output: Rundunar ‘yan sanda sun yi artabu da masu fafutukar kafa kasar Catalan kafin bikin karramawar kafa kasar.
rows.reference: ’Yan sanda sun yi arangama da masu neman ɓallewa na Catalan kafin zagayowar bikin neman ‘yanci

rows.output: An kama mutane shida a Barcelona a ranar Asabar bayan da masu fafutukar neman 'yancin kai suka yi ta kai hari kan 'yan sandan yaki, yayin da dubban mutane suka halarci zanga-zangar da suka yi a gaba da gaba domin tunawa da shekara ta farko da Catalonia ta gudanar da zaben raba kai mai tayar da hankali.
rows.reference: An kama mutane shida a Barcelona a ranar Asabar bayan masu zanga-zangar nuna goyon bayan ‘yanci sun yi fito-na-fito tare da ‘yan sandan kwantar da tarzoma, kuma kamar yadda dubun-dubata suka shiga zanga-zanga ta adawa da juna don bikin zagayowar ranar kaɗa kuri’a da ta raba Catalonia a kan ɓallewa.

rows.output: Wani gungun masu kare 'yancin kai masu sanye da abin rufe fuska sun yi karo da 'yan sandan da ke kare su da kwai da kuma fenti, wanda ya haifar da duhun hayaki a tituna da a al'ada ba a cika da masu yawon bude ido ba.
rows.reference: Wani gungu masu goyon bayan ɓallewar da suka rufe idanuwansu da ‘yan sanda suka riƙe sun jefe su da koyaye da kuma watsa musu fentin foda, inda suka ƙirƙiri wasu gajimare mai duhu a cikin titunan da yawanci sukan cika maƙil da ‘yan yawon shaƙatawa.

rows.output: An kuma yi ta rikici daga baya a ranar da ‘yan sanda suka yi amfani da sandunansu wajen shawo kan fadan.
rows.reference: Faɗace-faɗace sun ɓarke a ranar daga baya inda ‘yan sanda suka yi amfani da kulaƙensu don hana faɗan.

rows.output: A cikin sa'o'i da yawa, kungiyoyin da ke goyon bayan 'yancin kai sun yi ihu da "Babu mantawa, babu gafara," yayin da masu zanga-zangar hadin kai suka yi ihu da "Rayuwa a Spain."
rows.reference: Har fiye da tsawon sa’o’i masu yawa gungu-gungun masu goyon bayan ɓallewar suna amshi “Babu mantuwa, babu yafiya” sun yi rikici da masu zanga-zanga ‘yan son haɗewa suna ihu, Allah ya ja kwanan Spain.”

rows.output: Mutanen goma sha hudu sun samu magani saboda raunukan da ba su da yawa da aka samu a yayin zanga-zangar, a cewar kafafen yada labarai na cikin gida.
rows.reference: An yi magani a mutane goma sha huɗu don ƙananan raunuka da suka ji a zanga-zangogi, kamar yadda kafofin watsa labarai na gida suka ba da rahoto.

rows.output: Tashe-tashen hankula sun ci gaba da kasancewa a yankin da ke son yin garambawul shekara guda bayan zaben ranar 1 ga Oktoba da gwamnatin Madrid ta yi wa doka, amma kuma al'ummar Catalonia masu neman 'yanci suka yi bikin.
rows.reference: Har yanzu da tashin hankali sosai a lardin da ya sa ‘yanci a zuciyarsa shekara ɗaya bayan zaɓen raba gardama na 1 ga Oktoba wanda Madrid ke ɗauka ba ya bisa doka amma ‘yan Catalan masu neman ɓallewa ke ta yin murna da shi.

rows.output: Masu jefa kuri'a sun zabi da yawa su zama masu zaman kansu, duk da cewa an samu karancin fitowar masu kada kuri'a, inda wadanda ba su goyi bayan rabuwar kai suka fi yawa sun ki shiga zaben.
rows.reference: Masu jefa kuri’ar sun yi zaɓe sosai inda suka zaɓi ‘yanci kodayake ba a fito sosai ba inda waɗanda ba sa son ɓallewa suka ƙauracewa zaɓen.

rows.output: A cewar hukumomin Catalan, sama da mutane 1000 ne suka jikkata a shekarar da ta gabata bayan da ‘yan sanda suka yi yunkurin dakile zaben a rumfunan zabe a fadin yankin a lokacin tashin hankali.
rows.reference: A cewar hukumomin Catalan an aƙalla raunata mutane 1000 ne shekarar da ta wuce bayan ‘yan sanda sun yi ƙoƙarin su tsaida kaɗa kuri’ar da ake yi a wuraren jefa kuri’ar a dukkan faɗin lardin a cikin gumurzun tashin hankali.

rows.output: Ƙungiyoyin da ke goyon bayan 'yancin kai sun yi sansani a daren Juma'a don hana zanga-zangar nuna goyon baya ga 'yan sandan kasar.
rows.reference: Gungu-gungu na masu nuna goyon bayan ‘yanci sun yi dandazo waje da dare suna goyon baya na ‘yan sandan ƙasa.

rows.output: An gudanar da zanga-zangar amma an tilasta musu su dauki wata hanya ta daban.
rows.reference: Zanga-zangar ta ci gaba amma an tilasta mata ɗaukan wata hanya daban.

rows.output: Narcis Termes, mai shekaru 68, mai aikin lantarki da ya halarci zanga-zangar neman 'yancin kai tare da matarsa, ya bayyana cewa ya rasa fatan samun 'yancin kai na Catalonia.
rows.reference: Narcis Termes, mai shekaru 68, wani latirisha da ke halartar zanga-zangar ‘yan neman ɓallewar tare da matarsa ya ce ba ya kuma fatan ganin yiwuwar Catalonia ta sami ‘yanci.

rows.output: Shekarar da ta gabata muka yi rayuwa ta hanyar daya daga cikin mafi kyawun lokutan mu.
rows.reference: “Shekarar da ta wuce mun rayu a cikin ɗaya daga cikin lokacinmu mafi kyau.

rows.output: Na kalli iyayena suna kuka da farin ciki saboda suna da damar kada kuri'a amma yanzu muna makale," ya ce.
rows.reference: Na kalli iyayena suna kukan murna saboda damar jefa kuri’a amma yanzu mun tsaya ciki,” inji shi.

rows.output: Duk da cewa sun samu nasara mai matukar muhimmanci a zaben yankin da aka gudanar a watan Disamba na baya, jam'iyyun kishin kasa na Catalonia sun yi gwagwarmaya don ci gaba da samun karfin gwiwa a wannan shekarar, yayin da yawancin shugabanninsu da aka fi sani da su ke tsare ko kuma a tsare a jiran shari'a saboda rawar da suka taka wajen shirya zaben raba gardama da kuma sanar da 'yancin kai.
rows.reference: Duk da gudanar da wata muhimmiyar nasara ko da tsukekkiya ce a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan yankin a Disamba da ta wuce, jam’iyyun da ke goyon bayan ‘yanci na Catalan sun yi gwagwarmaya don su ci gaba da hazaƙar wannan shekarar tare da yawancin sanannun fitattun shugabanninsu ko dai sun tafi neman mafakar da suka sa kansu ko an kame su suna jiran shari’a don rawarsu da suka taka a cikin shirya zaɓen raba gardamar da furuci na ‘yanci da suka yi daga baya.

rows.output: Joan Puig, wani mai shekaru 42 mai aikin gyaran mota, wanda ke rubuta zanga-zangar goyon bayan ‘yan sanda a wayarsa, ya ce rikicin ya kara ta’azzara ne ta hanyar siyasa a bangarorin biyu.
rows.reference: Joan Puig, wani makanike mai shekaru 42 da ke daukan zanga-zanga a cikin goyon baya na ‘yan sanda a kan tarho dinsa, ya ce rikicin ya sami ruruwa ne daga ‘yan siyasa da ke dukkan bangarorin.

rows.output: "Yana kara zafi da zafi," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Yana ƙara ƙazanta sosai,” inji shi.

rows.output: A ranar Asabar, Oriol Junqueras, daya daga cikin shugabannin Catalonia tara da aka tsare tun farkon wannan shekarar, ya bayyana cewa zai tsaya takarar zaben majalisar dokokin Turai a shekara mai zuwa.
rows.reference: A ranar Asabar, Oriol Junqueras, ɗaya daga shugabanni tara na Catalan da ke tsare kafin a fara shari’a tun ƙarshen shekarar da ta wuce, ya sanar cewa zai tsaya zaɓuɓɓukan Majalisar Dokoki ta Turai a shekara mai zuwa.

rows.output: "Tsayawa takarar zaben Turai hanya ce mafi kyau ta nuna adawa da koma bayan dabi'un dimokuradiyya da zalunci da gwamnatin Spain ta yi," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Tsayawa a matsayin wani ɗan takara don zaɓuɓɓukan Turai shi ne hanya mafi kyau ta kin koma baya a kimomin dimokuraɗiyya da zalunci da muka gani daga gwamnatin Spain,” inji shi.

rows.output: Londonderry: Mutane da aka kama bayan mota ta shiga gidan
rows.reference: Londonderry: An kama masu maza bayan an doka mota a gida

rows.output: Maza uku masu shekaru 33, 34, da 39 an kama su bayan an tura mota cikin gida a Londonderry.
rows.reference: An kama wasu maza, masu shekaru 33, 34 da 29, bayan an ta maimaita doka wata ƙaramar mota zuwa cikin wani gida a da ke Londonderry.

rows.output: Lamarin ya faru ne a Ballynagard Crescent a ranar Alhamis da misalin karfe 19:30 na safe.
rows.reference: Abin ya faru ne a cikin Ballynagard Crescent a ranar Alhamis da kusan ƙarfe 19:30 BST.

rows.output: Det Insp Bob Blemmings ya ce an lalata kofofin kuma ginin da kansa.
rows.reference: Mataimakin Sufeto Bob Blemmings ya ce an lalata ƙofofi da ma gidan kansa.

rows.output: Wani kuma zai iya harba wani jirgin kasa a wani lokaci.
rows.reference: An kuma harba ƙila kwari da baka a kan ƙaramar motar a wani lokaci.

rows.output: Menga ya buga kwallo a raga ya ba Livingston nasara da ci 1-0 a kan Rangers
rows.reference: Cin da Menga ya yi ba wa Livingston nasara 1 da 0 a kan Rangers

rows.output: Dolly Menga ta zura kwallo ta farko ga Livingston ta samu nasara
rows.reference: Cin ƙwallon Dolly Menga ya ba wa Livingston samun nasara

rows.output: An yi wa Livingston tashin hankali, wanda ya sa Steven Gerrard ya yi rashin nasara na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 da ya yi a matsayin manajan kulob din Ibrox.
rows.reference: Livingston da aka ƙara wa girma ta ba da mamaki ga Rangers inda ta ajiye Steven Gerrard kawai zuwa ga cinsa da aka yi karo na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 a matsayinsa na manaja na kulob ɗin Ibrox.

rows.output: Kwallon da Dolly Menga ta yi ta zama bambamcin da ya yi, yayin da Gary Holt's side ta yi daidai da Hibernian a matsayi na biyu.
rows.reference: Harin da Dolly Menga ya yi ya kasance abin da kawo bambanci saboda ɓangaren Gary Holt ya motsa lebur tare da Hibernian a cikin mataki na biyu.

rows.output: Kungiyar Gerrard har yanzu ba ta samu nasara a waje a gasar Premiership a wannan kakar ba kuma za ta fuskanci kungiyar Hearts, wadda take bayan su da maki takwas, a ranar Lahadi mai zuwa.
rows.reference: Ɓangaren Gerrard yana nan ba tare da wata nasara da zai ta fi da ita ba a cikin wasan Premiership ɗin wannan lokacin kuma zai fuskanci Leaders Hearts, waɗanda suke bi da digo takwas, Lahadi mai zuwa.

rows.output: Kafin haka, Rangers suna karbar bakuncin Rapid Vienna a gasar Europa a ranar Alhamis.
rows.reference: Kafin nan, Rangers sun karɓi Rapid Vienna a cikin wasan Europa League a ranar Alhamis.

rows.output: Livingston, a halin yanzu, sun tsawaita wasannin da ba su yi rashin nasara ba a gasar zuwa wasanni shida, yayin da koci Holt bai yi rashin nasara ba tun da ya maye gurbin Kenny Miller a watan da ya gabata.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ake ciki hakan, Livinsgton, sun kara matsayinsu na ba wanda ya doke su a cikin shiyyar zuwa wasanni shida, tare da shugaban horar da wasa Holt har yanzu don ɗanɗana dokewa tun da ya maye gurbin Kenny Miler wata da ya wuce.

rows.output: Livingston sun rasa damar da suka samu a kan masu ziyara masu taurin kai
rows.reference: Livingston sun rasa damammaki a kan maziyartansu da ba su dama

rows.output: Kungiyar Holt ta kasance a gaba tun da dadewa kafin ta zura kwallo, saboda hanyoyin kai hari da suke yi wa Rangers sun haifar da matsala da yawa.
rows.reference: Ya kamata a ce ƙungiyar Holt suna gaba ne kafin su ci, tare da fuskantar tasu wanda ke haifar wa Rangers matsaloli iri-iri.

rows.output: Scott Robinson ya yi ta shiga tsakani amma ya yi yunkurin tayar da kafa, sannan Alan Lithgow ya yi ƙoƙari ya jagoranci ƙoƙarinsa ya faɗi bayan ya yi ƙoƙari ya haɗu da kai da Craig Halkett ya yi kai a cikin burin.
rows.reference: Scott Robinson ya shige ciki amma ya ja ƙoƙarinsa ta gaban fuska ta cin nasara, shi ke nan Alan Lithgow kawai zai iya fuskantar da ƙoƙarinsa bayan yin ƙasa don haɗuwa da bugu da ka na cin Craig Halkett.

rows.output: Masu karbar baki sun gamsu da barin Rangers su buga a gabansu, suna sane da cewa za su iya damun baƙi a lokacin da za a yi wasa.
rows.reference: Masu saukan bakin sun yarda su bar Rangers su buga wasa a gabansu, suna sane da cewa za su iya wahalar da masu ziyarar a jerin ɗaiɗaiku.

rows.output: Kuma haka ne aka samu muhimmin burin.
rows.reference: Kuma wancan shi ne yadda ci mai muhimmancin ya gudana.

rows.output: An ba wa Rangers bugun daga kai sai mai tsaron gida, kuma Livingston ya yi amfani da shi, Declan Gallagher da Robinson sun hada kai don sanya Menga, wanda ya dauki kwallo ya zura kwallo daga tsakiyar raga.
rows.reference: Rangers sun amince da bugun da ba tarewa kuma Livingston suka yi aiki da wata dama, Declan Gallagher da Robinson suka haɗe suka tsara Menga, wanda ya taɓa da kuma ci daga tsakiya ta akwatin.

rows.output: A lokacin, Rangers sun mamaye mallakar kwallo amma sun gano cewa tsaron gida ya yi matukar wahala kuma mai tsaron gida Liam Kelly ya yi kasa da matsin lamba,
rows.reference: A wannan mataki, Rangers ta mamaye riƙe ƙwallo amma ta sami tsaron gidan ba zai ba da damar wucewa ba kuma mai kama ƙwallo Liam Kelly kuma gaba ɗaya bai damu ba.

rows.output: Wannan tsarin ya ci gaba zuwa rabin na biyu, kodayake Alfredo Morelos ya tilasta wa Kelly ya yi tsalle.
rows.reference: Wannan yanayi ya ci gaba har rabi na biyu, kodayake Alfredo Morelos ya tilasta wani ceto daga Kelly.

rows.output: An hana Scott Pittman da ƙafafun mai tsaron gida na Rangers Allan McGregor, kuma Lithgow ya yi kuskure daga wani tsari na kafa da aka yi wa Livingston.
rows.reference: Scott Pittman bai samu dama ba daga ƙafa ta mai kama ƙwallo na Rangers Allan McGregor kuma Lithgow ya buɗa sosai daga wani wasan da Livingston ya tsara.

rows.output: Kwallaye sun ci gaba da shiga akwatin Livingston kuma sun ci gaba da tsaftace su, yayin da aka yi ikirarin hukuncin kai hari biyu - bayan kalubalen Halkett kan dan wasan da ya maye gurbin Glenn Middleton, da kuma wani don yin amfani da hannu - an yi watsi da su.

rows.reference: “Wata kaɗa kuri’a don tabbatar da Alkali Kavanaugh West jefa kuri’a ne don tabbatar da ɗaya daga cikin masana shari’a da suka cimma rayuwa a wannan lokacin namu, wani masanin shari’a da ke da fitaccen rubutaccen labari na aikin jama’a,” ya faɗa a dandazon jama’a magoya baya na Virginia ta Yamma.

rows.output: Shugaban kasar ya yi magana ta hanyar nuni da nadin Kavanaugh, yayin da yake tattaunawa kan muhimmancin fitowar jam’iyyar Republican a zaben tsakiyar wa’adi.
rows.reference: Shugaban ya ɗan yi tsokaci ne game da tura sunan Kavanaugh a yayin da yake magana game da amfani na fitowar ‘yan Republican a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan tsakiyar zango.

rows.output: "Kwanaki biyar kafin daya daga cikin zaben da ya fi muhimmanci a rayuwarmu.
rows.reference: “Saura makonni biyar zuwa ɗaya daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka mafi muhimmanci a lokutan rayuwarmu.

rows.output: Ba na gudu ba, amma ina gudu sosai," ya ce.
rows.reference: Ba zan tsaya ba, amma a zahiri zan tsaya,” inji shi.

rows.output: "Abin da ya sa nake yawo a ko'ina na fafatawa da manyan 'yan takara."
rows.reference: “Shi ne ya sa nake ko’ina ina yaƙi don manyan ‘yan takara.”

rows.output: Trump ya ce 'yan jam'iyyar Democrat suna da burin "juriya da toshewa."
rows.reference: Trump cikin mahawara ‘yan Democrat suna kan wata manufa ne ta “ƙi da taka burki.”

rows.output: An yi tsammanin za a gudanar da kuri'ar da ta fi muhimmanci a cikin majalisar dattijai kan zaben Kavanaugh ba daga baya ba fiye da Juma'a, wani jami'in shugabancin jam'iyyar GOP ya gaya wa CNN.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin farkon babban hanyar bi don kaɗa kuri’a a  daɗen Majalisar Dattawa a kan zaɓen Kavanaugh da za a yi da ba zai wuce Juma’a ba, a faɗar wani mai taimaka wa babban shugaba na GOP kamar yadda ya ce wa CNN.

rows.output: An kashe mutane da dama a cikin girgizar kasa da tsunami na kasar Indonesia, tare da yuwuwar karuwar adadin wadanda suka mutu.
rows.reference: Ɗaruruwa sun mace a sakamakon girgizar ƙasar Indonesiya, kuma ganin ƙarin mutuwar

rows.output: Aƙalla mutane 384 ne suka mutu, da yawa aka ɗauke su da igiyoyin ruwa yayin da manyan igiyoyin ruwa suka faɗo a bakin teku, bayan da wani babban girgizar ƙasa da tsunami suka afku a tsibirin Sulawesi na Indonesia, a cewar hukumomi a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: Aƙalla an kashe mutane 384, da tafiya da wasu saboda igiyoyin ruwa masu girma sun fado a kan bakin teku, a lokacin da wata babbar girgizar ƙasa da tsunami suka afka a tsibirin Sulawesi na Indonesiya, injin hukumomi a ranar Asabar.

rows.output: An yi taron jama'a da dama a bakin teku a birnin Palu a ranar Juma'a, lokacin da igiyoyin da suka kai mita shida (ƙafa 18) suka yi karo da bakin teku a lokacin faduwar rana, inda suka kwashe da yawa tare da lalata duk abin da ke cikin hanyarsu.
rows.reference: Ɗaruruwan mutane suka taru don wani biki a kan teku na birnin Palu a ranar Juma’a a yayin da igiyoyin ruwan da suka mitoci shiɗa a sama (taku 18) suka afka bakin teku da dare, inda suka share da yawa suka mutu da lalata kowane abu da ke hanyar tasu.

rows.output: An bi shi da wani girgizar kasa mai karfin awo 7.5.
rows.reference: Tsunamin ta biyo bayan wata girgizar ƙasa mai ƙarfin 7 da ɗigo 5.

rows.output: "Lokacin da aka samu barazanar tsunami jiya, mutane har yanzu suna yin ayyukansu a bakin teku kuma ba su gudu nan take ba, sai suka zama wadanda abin ya shafa," in ji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar kula da bala'i ta kasar Indonesia BNPB a wani taron manema labarai a Jakarta.
rows.reference: “A yayin da barazanar tsunamin ta taso jiya, mutane a lokacin suna ayyukansu ne a kan bakin tekun kuma ba su gudu nan da nan ba inda suka zama waɗanda abin ya shafa,” inji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar rage haɗura ta Indonesiya ta BNPB a cikin wata gajeruwar ganawa da ‘yan jarida a cikin Jakarta.

rows.output: "Ba a yi tsalle ba, ya ɗauki motoci, itatuwa, gidaje, ya buga komai a ƙasa," in ji Nugroho, yana ƙara cewa tsunami ya yi tafiya a cikin teku mai buɗewa da gudun kilomita 800 a cikin sa'a (kilomita 497 a cikin sa'a) kafin ya bugi bakin teku.
rows.reference: “Tsunamin tazo da kanta ne, ta jawo ƙananan motoci, katakwaye, gidaje, ta kuma bugi duk abin da ke kan ƙasa,” inji Nugroho, inda ya kara da cewa tsunami ta yi tafiya a faɗin buɗeɗɗen teku da gudu na kilomita 800 kowace sa’a (mil 497 kowace sa’a) kafin ta sauka a bakin tekun.

rows.output: Wasu mutane sun hau bishiyoyi don tserewa daga tsunami kuma sun tsira, ya ce.
rows.reference: Wasu mutanen sun hau bishiyoyi ne don tsira daga tsunami kuma sun rayu, inji shi.

rows.output: Kimanin mutane 16,700 an kwashe su zuwa cibiyoyi 24 a Palu.
rows.reference: An kwashe kusan mutane 16,700 zuwa cibiyoyi 24 da ke cikin Palu.

rows.output: Hotunan jiragen sama da hukumar bala'i ta fitar sun nuna cewa an lalata gine-gine da shaguna da dama, an karkatar da gada, an ruguje, kuma wata masallaci tana kewaye da ruwa.
rows.reference: Hotunan da aka ɗauka daga sama da hukumar haɗarin ta sake sun nuna gine-gine da shaguna a lalace, gadojin sun lankwashe da rushewa da wani masallaci ruwa ya kewaye shi.

rows.output: An ci gaba da yin girgizar kasa a cikin birnin bakin teku a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: An ci gaba da samun girgize-girgize na baya da suka addabi birnin da ke kusa da tekun a ranar Asabar.

rows.output: An yi jerin girgizar kasa a yankin da ke da mutane miliyan 2.4.
rows.reference: An ji girgize-girgizen ƙasa a jere a wani yanki mai mutane miliyan 2 da dubu ɗari 4.

rows.output: Hukumar tantancewa da amfani da fasaha ta Indonesia (BPPT) ta ce a cikin wata sanarwa cewa, makamashin da aka saki a lokacin girgizar kasa mai karfi a ranar Jumma'a ya kai kusan sau 200 fiye da karfin bam din atomic da aka jefa a Hiroshima a lokacin yakin duniya na biyu.
rows.reference: Hukumar Auna da Aiwatar da Fasaha ta Indonesiya (BPPT) a cikin wata sanarwa ta ce ƙarfi da babbar girgizar ƙasa ta sake a ranar Jumu’ar ya kai kusan sau 200 na ƙarfin bam na sinadarin atom da aka jefa a kan Hiroshima a cikin Yakin Duniya na Biyu.

rows.output: Yankin birnin, wanda ke kusa da ƙarshen wani dogon kogin ruwa mai tsawo, na iya ƙara girman tsunami, in ji.
rows.reference: Yanayi na birnin, wanda ke zaune a ƙarshe na wani ɗan ƙaramin ziri mai tsawo, ƙila shi ya faɗaɗa girma na tsunami ɗin, inji ta.

rows.output: Nugroho ya bayyana barnar a matsayin "mai yawa" ya kuma ce dubban gidaje, asibitoci, shaguna, da otal-otal sun ruguje.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya bayyana lalacewar a matsayin “mai yawa” kuma ya ce dubun-dubata na gidaje, asibitoci, shagunan cinikayya da otel-otel duk sun ruguje.

rows.output: An gano gawar wasu wadanda abin ya shafa sun makale a karkashin tarkacen gine-ginen da suka ruguje, ya ce, ya kuma bayyana cewa mutane 540 sun jikkata kuma 29 sun bace.
rows.reference: An sami gawarwakin waɗanda abin ya shafa a maƙale a ƙarƙashin gine-gine da suka rushe, inji shi, ya kuma ƙara da cewa mutane 540 sun ji rauni kuma an rasa 29.

rows.output: Nugroho ya ce, an samu asarar rayuka da kuma barna da za a iya samu a bakin teku mai nisan kilomita 300 (mil 190) a arewa da Palu, wani yanki mai suna Donggala, wanda ke kusa da tsakiyar girgizar kasa.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya ce yawan masu mutuwar da lalacewar zai ƙaru sosai a layin bakin teku kilomita 300 (mil 190) arewa da Palu, wani yanki da ake kira Donggala,

rows.output: Hanyoyin sadarwa sun kasance gaba daya cikin kunci ba tare da wani bayani ba daga Donggala, in ji Nugroho.
rows.reference: Sadarwa “gaba ɗaya sun tsaya cik kuma babu labari” daga Donggala, jinji Nugroho.

rows.output: Akwai sama da mutane 300,000 da ke zaune a wurin," kungiyar Red Cross ta ce a cikin wata sanarwa, inda ta kara da cewa ma'aikatansu da masu sa kai suna kan hanyar zuwa wuraren da abin ya shafa.
rows.reference: Akwai fiye da mutane 300,000 da ke zauna a can,” inji ƙungiyar agaji ta Red Cross a cikin wata sanarwa, tana mai ƙarin cewa ma’aikatanta da masu sa-kai sun nufi yankunan da abin ya shafa.

rows.output: "Wannan ya riga ya zama bala'i, amma zai iya kara tabarbarewa."
rows.reference: “Wannan tuni wani bala’i ne, amma zai iya ƙara muni,” inji ta.

rows.output: Hukumar ta fuskanci suka a ranar Asabar saboda rashin sanar da cewa wani tsunami ya afkawa Palu, duk da cewa jami'ai sun ce igiyoyin sun zo kafin a fitar da gargadin.
rows.reference: An soki hukumar a ranar Asabar sosai don rashin sanarwa cewa wata tsunami za ta afka wa Palu, kodayake jami’ai sun ce igiyoyin ruwa sun zo a tsakanin lokacin da aka fitar da gargaɗin.

rows.output: A cikin bidiyon da ba na kwararru ba da aka raba a shafukan sada zumunta, wani mutum a bene na sama na gini yana iya ganin yana yi wa mutane a titin da ke kasa gargaɗi cikin gaggawa game da igiyar ruwa da ke tafe.
rows.reference: Wani bidiyon da ba ƙwararre ba da aka raba ta kafar sada zumunta za a iya jin wani mutum a kan saman daɓe na wani gini yana ihun girgiza gargaɗi na kusantowar tsunami ga mutane da ke titin ƙasan.

rows.output: A cikin mintuna, katanga na ruwa ta fado kan bakin teku, tana ɗaukar gine-gine da motoci.
rows.reference: A cikin mintina wani bango na ruwa ya faɗo a kan tekun, yana ɗaukewa gine-gine da ƙananan motoci.

rows.output: Ba a iya tabbatar da fuskokin nan ba.
rows.reference: Kamfanin dillacin labarai na Reuters ba iya tantance bidiyon ba nan da nan.

rows.output: Guguwar da tsunami sun haifar da katsewar wutar lantarki mai girma da ta katse hanyoyin sadarwa a kusa da Palu, wanda ya sa ya yi wahala ga hukumomi su tsara ayyukan ceto.
rows.reference: Girgizar ƙasar da tsunamin sun haifar da katsewar lantarki da yanke sadarwa a kewayen Palu inda ya haifar da wahala ga hukumomi wajen haɗin gamayyar ƙoƙare-ƙoƙare na ceto.

rows.output: An fara aika jiragen sama masu kaya da agaji daga Jakarta da sauran birane, a cewar hukumomi, amma wadanda aka kwashe har yanzu suna bukatar abinci da sauran muhimman abubuwa.
rows.reference: Sojoji sun fara aika manyan jiragen ɗaukan kaya da tallafi daga Jakarta da sauran birane, inji hukumomi, amma waɗanda aka kwashen har yanzu suna sosai buƙatar abinci da sauran muhimman kayayyaki.

rows.output: Birnin ya bude filin jirgin sama ne kawai don ayyukan agaji kuma zai kasance a rufe har zuwa Oktoba.
rows.reference: An sake buɗe filin jirgin sama na birnin kaɗai don ƙoƙare-ƙoƙaren kayan agaji kuma zai kasance a rufe sai har Octoba.

rows.output: Shugaban Joko Widodo ya shirya ziyartar cibiyoyin gaggawa a Palu a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: An tsara Shugaba Joko Widodo zai ziyarci cibiyoyin kwashewa mutane a cikin Palu a ranar Lahadi.

rows.output: Indonesia: Mutuwar Tsunami ta haura 800.

rows.output: Yana da muni sosai.

rows.output: Yayin da ma'aikatan Vision na Duniya daga Donggala suka isa birnin Palu cikin aminci, inda ma'aikata ke kwana a cikin tarkacen tarkace da aka kafa a cikin fadar ofishinsu, sun ga al'amura masu lalacewa a kan hanyarsu, in ji Mista Doseba.
rows.reference: Kodayake ma’aikatan World Vision sun koma birnin Palu lafiya ƙalau daga Donggala, inda ma’aikatan ke zaune a matsugunan tanfol da aka kafa a farfajiyar ofishin nasu, sun nuna wani hali na rugujewa a kan hanyar, inji Mista Doseba.

rows.output: "Sun gaya mini sun ga gidaje da yawa da aka lalata," in ji shi.

rows.output: Yana da muni sosai.
rows.reference: Abin ya ɓaci sosai.

rows.output: Ko da yake kungiyoyin agaji sun fara aikin da ya dace na fara injin aikin agaji, wasu sun yi korafi cewa ma'aikatan agaji na kasashen waje masu zurfin ilimi sun hana su tafiya zuwa Palu.
rows.reference: Duk da gungu-gungun ‘yan agaji da suka fara wata babbar hoɓɓasa ta fara aikin tallafi na bala’i, wasu sun yi ƙorafi cewa ma’aikatan agaji na waje da ke ƙwarewa sosai ana hana su tafiya zuwa Palu.

rows.output: Bisa ga dokokin kasar Indonesia, samar da kudade, kayayyaki, da ma'aikata daga kasashen waje za su iya farawa ne kawai idan wurin bala'i an bayyana shi a matsayin yankin bala'i na kasa.
rows.reference: A cewar ƙa’idojin Indonesiya, kashe kuɗaɗe, samarwa da ba da ma’aikata daga ƙasashen waje kawai zai fara ne idan an furta wuri na fitina a matsayin zango na bala’i na ƙasa.

rows.output: Har yanzu haka bai faru ba.
rows.reference: Hakan har yanzu bai faru ba.

rows.output: "Har yanzu bala'i ne a matakin lardi," in ji Aulia Arriani, mai magana da yawun kungiyar agaji ta Indonesia.
rows.reference: “Har yanzu wani lebur ne yankin bala’i,” inji Aulia Arriani, mai magana da yawun Red Cross ta Indonesiya.

rows.output: "Da zarar gwamnati ta ce, "Lafiya, wannan wani bala'i ne na kasa," za mu iya bude don taimakon kasa da kasa amma har yanzu babu wani matsayi."
rows.reference: Da zarar gwamnatin ta ce, “Ya yi, wannan zai zama wani bala’i na ƙasa,” za mu buɗe don taimakon ƙasa-da-ƙasa amma babu matsayin har yanzu.”

rows.output: A ranar Juma'a bayan girgizar kasa da tsunami, abokan wadanda har yanzu ba a samu ba, da iyalansu suna fatan cewa masoyansu za su zama abubuwan al'ajabi da za su sa labarun tashin hankali na yanayi su yi kyau.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda dare na biyu ya faɗa kan Palu bayan girgizar ƙasa da tsunami ta ranar Jumu’a, abokai da iyali na waɗanda suka ɓata suna ta fatan cewa ‘yan uwan nasu za su zama mu’ujizozi da za su rayar da layukan labari marar daɗi na bala’o’i na ƙasa.

rows.output: A ranar Asabar, an ceto wani karamin yaro daga cikin bututun ruwa.
rows.reference: A ranar Asabar, an ciro wani ƙaramin yaro daga wata matattar datti.

rows.output: A ranar Lahadi ne, an ceto wata mata da aka makale a karkashin tarkacen gini tsawon kwanaki biyu tare da jikar mahaifiyarta a gefenta.
rows.reference: A ranar Lahadi, masu ceto sun ‘yantar da wata mata wanda ta kasance tana ƙarƙashin burbushi na kwanaki biyu tare da gawar mahaifiyarta kusa da ita.

rows.output: Gendon Subandono, shugaban tawagar paragliding ta kasa ta Indonesia, ya horar da biyu daga cikin masu yin paragliding da suka bace don gasar Asiya, wadda ta kare a baya a watan a Indonesia.
rows.reference: Gendon Subandono, mai horar da ‘yan wasa na Ɗƙungiyar ‘yan sauka daga sama na Indonesiya, ya horar da ‘yan wasan biyu da suka bace na Wasannin Asiya, wanda aka gama a farkon wannan watan a cikin Indonesiya.

rows.output: Wasu daga cikin wadanda aka kama a otal din Roa Roa, ciki har da Mista Mandagi, dalibansa ne.
rows.reference: Saura daga cikin waɗanda aka rutsa da su a otel ɗin Roa Roa, har da Mista Mandagi, ɗalibansa ne.

rows.output: "A matsayin babban mutum a fagen tashi da saukar jirgin sama, ina da nauyin zuciya na," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “A matsayi wani babba a cikin wasan saukowa daga saman, ni ma ina nawa taƙaicin da nake ji,” inji shi.

rows.output: Mista Gendon ya ba da labarin yadda, a sa'o'i bayan sanarwar rugujewar otal din Roa Roa ta bazu a cikin al'ummar paragliding, ya aika da saƙonnin WhatsApp cikin damuwa ga 'yan takarar Palu, waɗanda ke halartar bikin bakin teku.
rows.reference: Mista Gendon ya ba da bayanin yadda aka yi, a cikin sa’o’i bayan labarin rushewar otel ɗin Roa Roa da aka watsa a tsakanin al’ummar wasan saukowa daga saman, ya aika sakonnin WhatsApp a dugunzume zuwa masu gasa ta Palu, waɗanda ke shiga cikin bikin na bakin tekun.

rows.output: Saƙonninsa, duk da haka, ya haifar da alamar dubawa mai launin toka ɗaya kawai, maimakon ƙungiyar dubawa mai shuɗi.
rows.reference: Sakonninsa, kodayake, kawai sun haifar da alamar launin toka guda mai zane, a maimakon wani guda biyu na zane-zane shudi.

rows.output: Ina ganin hakan na nufin sakonnin ba a kai su ba," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ina jin yana nufi ba a aika sakonni ne ba,” inji shi.

rows.output: An sace dala 26,750 a lokacin da ake cika na'urar ATM a Newport on the Levee

rows.output: An sace dala 26,750 daga ma’aikacin Brink’s da ke cika na’urar ATM a Newport on the Levee a safiyar Juma’a, a cewar wata sanarwa da Sashen ‘yan sandan Newport ya fitar.
rows.reference: Ɓarayi a ranar Juma’a da safe sun sace dala 26,750 daga wurin wani ma’aikacin Brink da ke sake cika wani ATM a Newport a kan Daɓe, a cewar wani labari da aka sake daga Ma’aikatar ‘Yan Sanda ta Newport.

rows.output: An kama direban motar ne da ke zubar da wani ATM a cikin cibiyar nishadi kuma yana shirin kai wasu kudade, Det. Dennis McCarthy ya rubuta a cikin sanarwar.

rows.output: Yayin da yake cikin aiki, wani mutum ya gudu daga bayan ma'aikacin Brink ya sace jaka da kudi da za a kai.
rows.reference: A lokacin da yake cikin aiki, wani mutum “ya zo a guje daga bayan ma’aikacin na Brink” kuma ya saci jakar kuɗi da za a kawo.

rows.output: Shaidu sun ga masu zargi da yawa suna gudu daga wurin, a cewar sanarwar, amma ‘yan sanda ba su fayyace adadin wadanda abin ya shafa ba.
rows.reference: Shaidun gani da ido sun ga waɗanda ake zargi da yawa suna gudu daga wurin da aka yi laifin a cewar sanarwar, amma ‘yan sanda ba su fayyace yawan waɗanda ke cikin ba.

rows.output: Wadanda suka san wani abu game da asalin su su tuntubi ‘yan sandan Newport a 859-292-3680.

rows.output: Ya maye gurbin mawakiya Ariana Grande a kan wasan kwaikwayon da ta soke saboda "dalilan zuciya," kamar yadda mai kirkirar wasan kwaikwayon ya ce.

rows.output: Haka kuma, an gajarta sunansa na sana'a a halin yanzu, West ya ce kalmar tana da muhimmanci a addini a gare shi.

rows.output: Na yi imani "kai" shine kalmar da aka fi amfani da ita a cikin Littafi Mai Tsarki, kuma a cikin Littafi Mai Tsarki yana nufin "kai," in ji West a baya a wannan shekara, yana tattaunawa kan taken kundin sa tare da mai gabatar da shirye-shiryen rediyo Big Boy.

rows.output: Makarantar AMLO ta yi alkawarin ba za ta yi amfani da sojoji a kan fararen hula ba
rows.reference: AMLO na Mexico ya yi alkawarin ba zai yi amfani da sojoji a kan fararen hula ba

rows.output: Shugaban kasar Mexico mai jiran gado Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawarin cewa ba zai taba amfani da karfin soji a kan fararen hula ba yayin da kasar ke gab da cika shekaru 50 da wani mummunan tashin hankali da aka yi wa dalibai.
rows.reference: Zaɓaɓɓen Shugaban Ƙasar Mexico Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawarin ba zai taɓa yin amfani da ƙarfin soja a kan fararen hula ba a yayin da ƙasar ke kusantar cika shekaru 50 na wani murƙushewar da aka yi wa ɗalibai da aka zubar da jini.

rows.output: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari a ranar Asabar a filin Tlatelolco da ba zai taba amfani da sojoji wajen zaluntar al’ummar Mexico ba.
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari ranar Asabar a Tlatelolco Plaza “kar a taɓa ko kaɗan amfani da sojoji wajen murƙushe mutanen Mexico.”

rows.output: An harbe mutane a wani zanga-zangar zaman lafiya a filin jirgin sama a ranar 2 ga Oktoba, 1968, inda aka kashe mutane kusan 300 a lokacin da motsin daliban hagu ke fara yaduwa a duk Latin Amurka.
rows.reference: Rundunonin sun yi harbi a kan wata zanga-zangar lumana a cibiyar a ranar 2 ga Oktoba, 1968, inda suka kashe da yawa har mutane 300 a wani lokaci yayin da ɗalibai ‘yan gwagwarmayar ra’ayin gurguzu suka fara samun matsuguni a Latin America.

rows.output: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari zai tallafa wa matasa 'yan Mexico ta hanyar bayar da tallafin wata-wata ga wadanda ke karatu da kuma bude karin jami'o'in jama'a kyauta.
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari na goyon bayan samari ‘yan Mexico ta ba da tallafe-tallafe na wata-wata ga waɗanda ke karatu kuma da buɗe ƙarin jami’o’i na gwamnati kyauta.

rows.output: Ya ce rashin aikin yi da kuma rashin damar ilimi yana jawo matasa zuwa kungiyoyin laifuka.
rows.reference: Ya kuma ce rashin aikin yi da wani rashi na damammakin ilmi su ne ke jan samari zuwa gungun ƙungiyoyi masu aikata laifi.

rows.output: Amurka ta kamata ta ninka kudaden binciken A.I.
rows.reference: Ya kamata Amurka ta ruɓanya kuɗin A.I.

rows.output: Yayin da kasar Sin ke kara shiga harkar basirar wucin gadi, ya kamata Amurka ta ninka kudaden da take kashewa wajen bincike a fannin, in ji masu zuba jari da masu aikin AI Kai-Fu Lee, wanda ya yi aiki a Google, Microsoft da Apple.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda China ta zama tana aiki sosai a cikin hikimar da ba ta asali ba, ya kamata Amurka ta ruɓanya yawan abin da take kashewa a cikin nazari da ke cikin filin, inji mai zuba jari mai gwada hikimar da ba ta asalin ba Kai-Fu Lee, wanda ya yi aiki da Google, Microsoft da Apple.

rows.output: Bayanin ya zo ne bayan da sassa daban-daban na gwamnatin Amurka sun yi sanarwa game da AI, duk da cewa Amurka gabaɗaya ba ta da wata dabarar AI ta hukuma.
rows.reference: Sharhohin suna zuwa ne bayan ɓangarori da dama na gwamnatin Amurka sun yi furuci a kan AI na hikimar da ba ta asalin ba, duk da cewa Amurka ta rasa wata dabarar AI a  tsare.

rows.output: A lokaci guda, Sin ta gabatar da shirinta a shekarar da ta gabata: tana da burin zama No.1 a cikin kirkire-kirkire na AI kafin 2030.
rows.reference: A halin da ake cikin, China ta gabatar da shirinta shekarar da ta wuce: tana ƙoƙarin ta zama ta farko a cikin ƙago AI a shekara ta 2030.

rows.output: "Ƙara kasafin kuɗin binciken AI sau biyu zai zama kyakkyawan farawa, idan aka yi la'akari da cewa duk sauran ƙasashe suna da nisa sosai a bayan Amurka, kuma muna neman gagarumin ci gaba a AI," in ji Lee.
rows.reference: “Ruɓanya kasafin kuɗi na AI zai zama wani mafari mai kyau, ganin cewa dukkan sauran ƙasashe sun yi gaba sosai a bayan Amurka kuma muna neman wani sabon abu a cikin AI,” inji Lee.

rows.output: Daidaita kudade na iya ninka yuwuwar cewa babban nasarar AI na gaba za a samu a Amurka, Lee ya gaya wa CNBC a wata hira da aka yi a wannan makon.
rows.reference: Ruɓanya kashe kuɗi zai iya rubanya damammaki inda za a cimma babban AI na gaba a cikin Amurka, Lee ya ce wa CNBC a cikin wata intabiyu wannan makon.

rows.output: To, littafinta mai suna "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order" an buga shi a wannan watan ta Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, shi ne shugaban kamfanin Sinovation Ventures, wanda ya zuba jari a daya daga cikin manyan kamfanonin AI a kasar Sin, Face++.
rows.reference: Lee, wanda Houghton Mifflin Harcourt ya buga littafinsa "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order"  wannan watan, shi ne Babban Shugaba na Sinovation Ventures China, wanda ya zuba jari a cikin daya daga sanannun kamfanonin AI a cikin China, Face++.

rows.output: A cikin 1980s a Jami'ar Carnegie Mellon, ya yi aiki kan tsarin AI wanda ya doke mafi kyawun dan wasan Othello na Amurka, kuma daga baya ya kasance babban jami'in bincike na Microsoft kuma shugaban rassa na Google na kasar Sin.
rows.reference: A cikin shekaru na 1980 a Jami’ar Carnegie Mellon ya yi aiki a kan wani tsarin AI da ya doke ɗan wasan Amurka Othello da ya fi matsayi, daga baya kuma ya zama wani zababben shugaba a Microsoft Research da shugaban Google na reshen China.

rows.output: Lee ta amince da gasar fasahar gwamnatin Amurka a baya kamar kalubalen binciken fasahar tsaro na hukumar binciken fasahar tsaro ta DARPA da kuma tambayar lokacin da na gaba zai kasance, domin taimakawa wajen gano masu hangen nesa na gaba.
rows.reference: Lee ya faɗi gasa ta baya ta gwamnatin Amurka a kan fasaha kamar Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's Robotics Challenge inda ya tambaya yaushe ne za a yi na gaban, saboda ya taimaka gane masu hange nesa na gaba.

rows.output: Masana kimiyya a Amurka galibi suna buƙatar yin aiki tuƙuru don samun tallafin gwamnati, in ji Lee.
rows.reference: Manazarta a cikin Amurka yawanci sukan yi aiki tuƙuru saboda cin taimakon kuɗaɗen gwamnati, inji Lee.

rows.output: "Ba kasar Sin ne ke daukar shugabannin ilimi ba; kamfanoni ne," in ji Lee.
rows.reference: “Ba China ne ke ɗaukewa shugabannin ilmi ba; kamfanoni ne,” inji Lee.

rows.output: Facebook, Google, da sauran kamfanonin fasaha sun dauki gwararru daga jami'o'i don yin aiki kan AI a cikin shekaru masu zuwa.
rows.reference: Facebook, Google da sauran kamfanonin fasaha sun ɗauki hayar manyan masu ilmi daga jami’o’i don aiki a kan AI a shekarun kwana nan.

rows.output: Lee ya ce canje-canjen manufofin shige da fice na iya taimakawa Amurka wajen karfafa kokarinta na AI.
rows.reference: Lee ya ce canje-canjen ƙudurin shiga ƙasa zai iya kuma taimakon Amurka ta daga ƙoƙare-ƙoƙarenta na AI.

rows.output: Ina ganin katunan kore ya kamata a ba su ta atomatik ga wadanda suka kammala PhD a fannin AI, in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Ina jin ya kamata korayen katina su zama kai-tsaye ake samar da su ga masu digirin-digirgir a fannin hikimar AI da ba ta asali ba,” inji shi.

rows.output: An ba da umarnin Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta China a watan Yuli 2017.
rows.reference: Majalisar Ƙasar China ta fitar da Shirin Ci Gaban Hikimar Da Ba Ta Asali Don Al’ummar Gaba nata a cikin Yulin 2017.

rows.output: Asusun Kimiyya na Duniya na kasar Sin yana ba da tallafi ga mutane a cibiyoyin ilimi ta hanyar da ta yi kama da yadda Asusun Kimiyya na Kasa da sauran hukumomin gwamnati ke ba da kuɗi ga masu bincike a Amurka, amma ingancin aikin ilimi ya yi ƙasa da na China, in ji Lee.
rows.reference: Gidauniyar Kimiyya na Halitta ta Ƙasa ta China ta samar da kuɗaɗe ga mutane a makarantun ilmi irin zuwa ga hanyar da Gidauniyar Kimiyyar ta Ƙasa da sauran hukumomin gwamnati ke ba da kuɗi ga manazartan Amurka, amma yanayin darajar aikin ilmi ya yi ƙasa a cikin China, inji Lee.

rows.output: A farkon wannan shekarar, Ma'aikatar Tsaron Amurka ta kafa Cibiyar Haɗin Gwiwar Hankali na Wucin Gadi, wacce aka yi niyya don haɗa abokan tarayya daga masana'antu da ilimi, kuma Fadar White House ta sanar da kafa Kwamitin Zaɓe na Hankali na Wucin Gadi.
rows.reference: A farkon wannan shekarar Ma’aikatar Tsaro ta Amurka ta kafa wata Cibiyar Hikimar Da Ba Ta Asali Ba, wanda aka shirya don ta sa abokan hulɗa daga masana’anta da makaranta, kuma fadar White House ta sanar da ƙirƙirar wani Zaɓaɓɓen Kwamiti a kan Hikimar da ba ta asali ba.

rows.output: Kuma a wannan watan, DARPA ta sanar da zuba jarin dala biliyan 2 a wani shiri mai suna AI Next.
rows.reference: Kuma wannan watan DARPA ta sanar da zuba jarin dala biliyan 2 a cikin wani ƙoƙari da ake kira AI Next.

rows.output: Game da NSF, a halin yanzu tana saka sama da dala miliyan 100 a duk shekara a binciken AI.
rows.reference: A game da NSF, a yanzu haka ta zuba jarin fiye da dala miliyan 100 a kowace shekara a cikin binciken AI.

rows.output: A lokaci guda, dokar Amurka da ke neman kafa hukumar tsaro ta kasa kan hankali na wucin gadi ba ta samu ci gaba ba cikin watanni.
rows.reference: A halin da ake ciki yanzu, dokar Amurka da ke neman ƙirƙirar wata Hukumar Tsaron Ƙasa kan Hikimar Da Ba Asali tana nan ba ta ga wani aiki ba a cikin watanni.

rows.output: Macedonians sun kada kuri'a a zaben kan ko za a canza sunan kasar
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia suna jefa kuri’ar raba gardama a kan ko a canza sunan ƙasar

rows.output: An yi zaben a ranar Lahadi kan ko za a canza sunan kasar zuwa "Jamhuriyar Masedoniya ta Arewa," wani mataki da zai warware rikicin da ya dade da yawa da kasar Girka, wadda ta hana neman mambobinta na Tarayyar Turai da NATO.
rows.reference: Mutanen Macedonia sun jefa kuri’a a cikin wata raba gardama a ranar Lahadi ko ta canza sunanta zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Arewacin Macedonia,” a wani yinƙuri da zai warware wata tsohuwar taƙaddama tare da Greece wadda ta toshe nemanta na zama mamba don Tarayyar Turai da NATO.

rows.output: Girka, wadda ke da lardi mai suna Masedoniya, ta tabbatar da cewa sunan makwabtarta na arewa yana nuni da ikirarin yankinta kuma ta hana shigarta NATO da EU.
rows.reference: Greece, wadda ke da wani yanki da ake kira Macedonia, ya nace da cewa sunan makwabciyarta ta arewa yana wakiltar wani nema ne a kan iyakarta kuma ta hau-kujerar-na-ki na shiganta cikin NATO da Tarayyar Turai.

rows.output: Gwamnatocin biyu sun kulla yarjejeniya a watan Yuni bisa sunan da aka gabatar, amma masu adawa da kishin kasa sun ce canjin zai raunana asalin kabilanci na mafi yawan al’ummar Slavic na Masedoniya.
rows.reference: Gwamnatin biyu sun sami wata matsayi a Yuni a bisa wani sabon suna da suka ƙudurta, amma masu adawa na ‘yan kasanci sun yi mahawara canjin zai rage shaidar ƙabilanci na jama’a ‘yan Slav da suka yawa na Macedonia.

rows.output: Shugaban kasar Gjorge Ivanov ya bayyana cewa ba zai kada kuri'a ba a zaben, kuma yakin neman zaben ya haifar da shakku ko za a samu kuri'u da ake bukata na kashi 50 cikin 100 na kuri'un da ake bukata domin a yi zaben.
rows.reference: Shugaba Gjorge Ivanov ya ce ba zai yi zaɓe a cikin raba gardamar ba kuma wani kamfe na ƙauracewa ya sa shakku a kan ko yawan fitowar zai isa matsaikacin kashi 50 cikin ɗari da ake buƙata don raba gardamar ta inganta.

rows.output: Tambayar a kan kuri'ar raba gardama ta karanta: "Kuna goyon bayan shiga NATO da EU tare da karɓar yarjejeniyar da Girka."
rows.reference: Tambayar da ke kan kuri’ar raba gardamar tana cewa: “Kai na NATO da zama mamban Tarayyar Turai ne da yarda da yarjejeniyar tare da Greece.”

rows.output: Masu goyon bayan sauya sunan, ciki har da Firayim Minista Zoran Zaev, suna jayayya cewa hakan farashi ne da za a biya don neman shiga cikin kungiyoyi kamar EU da NATO ga Masedoniya, daya daga cikin kasashen da suka fito daga rugujewar Yugoslavia.
rows.reference: Masu goyon bayan canza sunan, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, sun yi mahawara cewa wata sadaukarwa ce don bin shiga cikin hukumomin kamar su Tarayyar Turai da NATO don Macedonia, ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashe da suka bayyana daga rushewa ta Yugoslavia.

rows.output: Na zo yau ne domin kada kuri’a ga makomar kasar, ga matasa a Masedoniya su samu rayuwa cikin ‘yanci a karkashin inuwar Tarayyar Turai domin yana nufin rayuwa mai aminci ga kowa.
rows.reference: “Na zo nan yau don jefa kuri’a don makoma ta ƙasar, don mutane samari a cikin Macedonia saboda za su iya rayuwa da ‘yanci a ƙarƙashin lema ta Tarayyar Turai saboda yana nufin rayuwa mai tsaro a gare mu,” inji Olivera Georgijevska, mai shekaru 79, a cikin Skopje.

rows.output: Duk da cewa ba a iya tilasta shi ta hanyar shari'a ba, amma isassun mambobin majalisar dokoki sun bayyana cewa za su bi sakamakon kuri'ar don sanya shi mai karfi.
rows.reference: Kodayake ba ya da ƙarfi na shari’a, isassun mambobi na majalisar dokoki sun ce za su bi sakamako na jefa kuri’ar don ta zama ta daidaita.

rows.output: Sake suna zai bukaci kashi biyu bisa uku na majalisar dokoki.
rows.reference: Canza sunan zai buƙaci wan yawa na kashi biyu bisa uku na majalisar dokokin.

rows.output: Hukumar zabe ta jihar ta ce ba a samu rahoton wani abu ba da misalin karfe 1 na rana.
rows.reference: Hukumar zaɓe ta ƙasar ta ce babu rahotanni na matsaloli har zuwa ƙarfe 1 na rana.

rows.output: Duk da haka, fitowar masu jefa kuri'a ta kai kashi 16 cikin 100, idan aka kwatanta da kashi 34 cikin 100 a zaben majalisar dokokin 2016, lokacin da kashi 66 cikin 100 na masu rajista suka kada kuri'unsu.
rows.reference: Amma, fitowar ta tsaya kawai a kashi 15 cikin ɗari, idan an kwatanta da kashi 34 a cikin ɗari a zaɓen majalisar dokoki na 2016 a yayin da kashi 66 cikin ɗari na masu jefa kuri’a da ke rijista suka kaɗa kuri’arsu.

rows.output: "Na fito ina zabe saboda 'ya'yana, wurin mu yana Turai," in ji Gjose Tanevski, mai shekaru 62, wanda ya zabe a babban birnin, Skopje.
rows.reference: “Na fito ne don jefa kuri’a saboda ‘ya’yana, matsayinmu yana cikin Turai ne,” inji Gjose Tanevski, mai shekaru 62, wani mai jefa kuri’a cikin babban birnin, Skopje.

rows.output: Ndị omeiwu Welsh na-echegbu onwe ha banyere "ịdị ka ndị na-eme ihe nkiri"
rows.reference: Welsh AM na enwe mgbakasị ahụ maka ‘ị dị ka ihe egwuregwu’

rows.output: Enwere ụjọ n'etiti ụfọdụ AMs maka aro na a ga-agbanwe aha ha ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Onye otu nzuko Welsh).
rows.reference: Enwere nchekasị ahụ n’ime ụfọdụ AMs maka ntụle na ekwesịrị ịgbanwe aha ha ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).

rows.output: Ọ na-eme n'ihi atụmatụ ịgbanwe aha nzuko ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Ụlọ Nzukọ Welsh.
rows.reference: Ọ malitere n’ihi atụmatụ nke ịgbanwe aha nke ndị otu obodo ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Nzụkọ Omeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: Ndị AMs n'ofe ọdịdị ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na-echegbu onwe ha na ọ nwere ike ịkpata ihere.
rows.reference: AMs n’ofe ụdị ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị dị iche iche na enwe nchekasị ahụ na ọ nwere ike ibute ihe mkparị.

rows.output: Otu ndi ọrụ kwuru na otu ya nwere nchegbu "na ọ na-ada ụda dị ka Twp na Pwp."
rows.reference: Otu AM nke Labour kwuru na ndị otu ya na echekasị na “ọ na ada ka Twp na Pwp.”

rows.output: Maka ndị na-agụ n'èzí Wales: N'asụsụ Welsh, twp pụtara onye ara ara na pwp pụtara ihe mkpofu.
rows.reference: Maka ndị ọgụ akwụkwọ nọ na mpụga Wales: Na Welsh twp pụtara iberibe, pwp pụtara nsị.

rows.output: Otu Plaid AM kwuru na otu ahụ n'ozuzu ya "adịghị enwe obi ụtọ" ma tụọ aro ihe ndị ọzọ.
rows.reference: AM Yi Uwe Ajị Anụ kwuru na otu ahụ dị ka dum “na ewe iwe”, na ọ nwere ihe ndị ọzọ atụnyere.

rows.output: Onye Conservative Welsh kwuru na ìgwè ya "na-emeghe uche" banyere mgbanwe aha ahụ, ma kwuo na ọ bụ obere ịwụ elu okwu site na MWP ruo Muppet.
rows.reference: Otu onye Kọnzavetiv Welsh kwuru na otu ya “meghere obi emeghe” gbasara mgbanwe aha ahụ, mana kwupụta na ọ bụ mkpumkpu nwụfe okwu site na MWP gaa na Ihe Egwuregwu.

rows.output: N'okwu a, mkpụrụedemede Welsh w na-ada ụda dị ka ụda Yorkshire English nke mkpụrụedemede u.
rows.reference: Na nghọta a ana akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede w nke Welsh otu ụzọ ka esi akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede u nke Bekee nke Yorkshire.

rows.output: Ụlọ omebe iwu, nke na-ede iwu ugbu a iji webata mgbanwe aha, kwuru: "Mkpebi ikpeazụ banyere ihe ọ bụla na-akọwa ihe ndị omebe iwu na-akpọ ga-adabere n'aka ndị otu n'onwe ha."
rows.reference: Kọmishọn nke Mgbakọ Mba ahụ, nke na edepụta iwu iji bubata mgbanwe aha ahụ, kwuru: “Mkpebi ikpeazụ na ihe nkọwa ọ bụla nke a na akpọ Ndị Otu nke Mgbakọ Mba ga-abụ okwu maka ndị otu n’onwe ha.”

rows.output: Iwu Ọchịchị Wales 2017 nyere ndị ọchịchị Welsh ikike ịgbanwe aha ya.
rows.reference: Gọọmentị nke Atụmatụ Wales 2017 nyere mgbakọ mba Welsh ikike iji gbanwee aha ya.

rows.output: N'ọnwa Jun, kọmiti ahụ bipụtara nsonaazụ nke nzukọ ọha na eze banyere atụmatụ ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado sara mbara maka ịkpọ ọgbakọ ahụ dị ka Ụlọ Nzukọ Welsh.
rows.reference: Na Juun, Kọmịshọn ahụ bipụtara nsonaazụ nke ndụmọdụ ọhaneze na ebumnuche ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado gbasara agbasa maka ịkpọ mgbakọ mba ahụ Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: N'ihe gbasara aha AMs, kọmishọna ahụ tụrụ aro ndị omebe iwu Welsh ma ọ bụ WMPs, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kacha n'ịkpọ oku ọha.
rows.reference: N’okwu nke aha nke ndị AM, Kọmịshọn ahụ dabedoro na Ndị Otu Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh ma ọ bụ WMP, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kachasị n’aka ndụmọdụ nke ọhaneze.

rows.output: Ndị AM na-egosi na ha na-atụ aro nhọrọ ndị ọzọ, mana ọgụ iji nweta nkwekọrịta nwere ike ịbụ isi ọwụwa maka Onye isi oche na-ahụ maka Elin Jones, onye a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-ebuga ụdị iwu maka mgbanwe n'ime izu ole na ole.

rows.output: Ndị Athens na-ekwu ogologo oge na aha onye agbata obi ha n'ebe ugwu na-anọchi anya ihe ha na-ekwu na ha nwere n'ala ha, ha na-ewepụkwa ugboro ugboro na ha na-achọ ịbanye na EU na NATO.
rows.reference: Oteela Athens kwubere na aha nke ndị agbataobi ya nọ n’ugwu na egosipụta nzọrọ na mpaghara ya, ha agaala n’ihu na egbochi arịrịọ nsonye ya maka EU na NATO.

rows.output: Onye isi ala Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, onye na-emegide ntuli aka gbasara mgbanwe aha, ekwuola na ya ga-ajụ votu ahụ.

rows.output: Mkpọmkpọm ọkụ nke St. Martin na-ada ụda ka ụka na Harlem na-agba mgba
